subject: Educational Psychology
stem: A teacher notices that giving a student the same sticker reward repeatedly, day after day, gradually stops motivating the student at all, as the reward loses its appeal from overuse. This reduction in a reinforcer's effectiveness due to excessive repeated presentation is called:
explanation: Satiation occurs when a reinforcer is used so repeatedly that it loses its motivating value — distinct from extinction, where a behaviour weakens because reinforcement is withheld entirely (not because the reinforcer itself has become less appealing).
